source: VA.gov published rates, DoD TA policy

postGiBill.name: Post-9/11 GI Bill

tuition.publicOutOfState: Full in-state tuition & fees (some states waive difference via Veterans Access Act)

postGiBill.monthlyHousing: E-5 with dependents BAH rate at school ZIP (full-time only)
postGiBill.housingOnlineOnlyNote: 50% of national average BAH for E-5 w/dep
postGiBill.yellowRibbon: School-specific: VA matches school's contribution dollar-for-dollar above the cap

kicker.note: Additional $100-$950/month if you contributed to MGIB and elected Post-9/11

eligibilityTiers.description: 36+ months active duty or Purple Heart
12-17 months active duty (or 30+ days with disability discharge)
6-11 months active duty (only with disability discharge)

transferRules.serviceObligation: Must commit to 4 additional years of service at time of transfer

montgomeryGiBill.name: Montgomery GI Bill (MGIB)

buyUp.note: Pay $600 during service for extra $150/month ($5,400 total benefit)

montgomeryGiBill.note: Most veterans benefit from switching to Post-9/11 GI Bill. MGIB may be better if: (1) attending a very cheap school where the flat rate exceeds tuition+housing, (2) attending online-only and want higher payment than Post-9/11 online rate, or (3) living in a very low-cost area.

vrAndE.name: Veteran Readiness & Employment (VR&E)
vrAndE.formalName: Veteran Readiness and Employment (formerly Vocational Rehabilitation)
vrAndE.maxMonthsNote: Up to 48 months; can extend beyond with VA approval for certain programs
vrAndE.tuition: No cap — full tuition and fees at any approved school
vrAndE.subsistenceAllowance: Same as Post-9/11 GI Bill housing rate (E-5 w/dep BAH at school ZIP for full-time)
vrAndE.booksAndSupplies: Actual costs covered (no cap, must be required for program)
vrAndE.equipment: Laptop, software, tools, uniforms, and supplies if required for program
vrAndE.employmentServices: Resume writing, interview prep, job placement assistance, follow-up for 60 months after employment

eligibility.disabilityRating: 10% or higher service-connected rating with employment handicap, OR 20% or higher with serious employment handicap
eligibility.timeLimit: Generally within 12 years of discharge or VA rating notification
eligibility.note: Employment handicap means your disability creates a barrier to preparing for, obtaining, or maintaining suitable employment

tracks.name: Reemployment
tracks.description: Return to your previous employer with accommodations for your disability

tracks.name: Rapid Access to Employment
tracks.description: Short-term training, certifications, or resume services to get employed quickly in a field matching your skills

tracks.name: Self-Employment
tracks.description: VA provides business plan development, tools, equipment, inventory, and business consulting to start your own business

tracks.name: Employment Through Long-Term Services
tracks.description: Full degree programs (associate through doctorate), certifications, and OJT. This is where the 48-month education benefit applies.

tracks.name: Independent Living
tracks.description: For veterans with serious disabilities affecting daily living. Services to increase independence at home and in the community.

advantages: No tuition cap (vs $26,381 GI Bill private school cap)
Books, supplies, laptop, tools covered at actual cost
Employment services and job placement for 5 years after completion
Can be used after GI Bill is exhausted for additional months
Self-employment track can fund a business startup
Subsistence during breaks between terms (long-term track)

tuitionAssistance.name: Tuition Assistance (TA)
tuitionAssistance.eligibility: Active duty (each branch has specific time-in-service requirements, typically 1 year)
tuitionAssistance.serviceObligation: Must serve 2 years after using TA or repay proportionally
tuitionAssistance.note: Does not reduce GI Bill months. Can be used simultaneously with GI Bill top-up in some cases.

marines.waitPeriod: 24 months TIS for first TA use

credentialingAssistance.name: Credentialing Assistance (CA)
credentialingAssistance.covers: Certifications, licenses, and associated prep courses and exams
credentialingAssistance.note: Separate from TA — can use both in the same year ($8,500 combined)

vetTec.name: VET TEC (Veteran Employment Through Technology Education Courses)
vetTec.tuition: Full tuition covered (paid to training provider)
vetTec.housing: E-5 w/dep BAH at training location (same as GI Bill)
vetTec.giMonthsUsed: Does not consume GI Bill months (but must have at least 1 day of unexpired GI Bill eligibility)
vetTec.note: One of the most underutilized VA benefits. Free coding bootcamp + full BAH with essentially no GI Bill cost.
